text:
rachel: heads up — deploy-bot paused the staged rollout for checkout-service (prom-20260324-21). Canary in eu-west showed a different image digest than the umbrella values expected. @omar can you triage? :frowning_face:

deploy-bot: Promotion prom-20260324-21 PAUSED. Reason: image tag v5.0.2 resolves to different digests in registries.
- eu-west digest: sha256:aa11ff...
- us-east digest: sha256:dd22ee...
Check: /deploy/prom-20260324-21/inspection. Action: HOLD until manual ack or values digest pin.

omar: looking at chart publish logs — chartmuseum replication to eu failed for a short window while ci:docker pushed the same tag twice (registry rewrite). Tag v5.0.2 was re-pushed in us-east with a new digest. eu pulled the original.

sre-oncall: change window closes in 28m. options: 1) pin digest in values for prod-eu and continue; 2) revert umbrella values to previous tag v5.0.1 and re-run canary; 3) abort promotion. Which carries least risk?

rachel: v5.0.2 includes a metrics label rename but no migrations. Pin seems lowest blast radius. If we pin, add a terse rollback playbook and a 15m high-sensitivity monitor after promote.

infra-bot: Note: chartmuseum replication lag detected at 2026-03-24T10:12:05Z. Affected artifacts: checkout-chart v5.0.2. See infra/ops/replication/logs/33045.

omar: agreed, pin + promote. I'll open a tiny values PR setting `image.digest` for eu and global to the eu digest and include a follow-up to flip to v5.0.2 tag after registries reconcile.

release-manager: fine with pinning. Please include a single-line release note and mark as non-user-facing. Also add an explicit step in the PR to run a canary smoke check post-promote.

omar: PR opened: https://git.redwood/checkout/compare/pin-eu-digest-20260324 (CI started). PR body includes a rollback snippet and verification steps: 
```
# rollout command
helm upgrade checkout ./charts/checkout --namespace prod --set image.digest=sha256:aa11ff... --reuse-values --wait
# verify
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=checkout -o wide
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/checkout --timeout=4m
# rollback if >5% errors
helm rollback checkout 2 --namespace prod
```

deploy-bot: Manual promotion requires `release-manager` ack. Use `deploy-bot promote --id prom-20260324-21 --manual-ack <user>` to continue.

release-manager: approving now. running manual promote once CI finishes.

sre-oncall: I'll add a temporary alert: checkout-service 5xx rate > 1% for 5m and pod restarts > 1 in 10m. Monitoring window: 15m post-promote.

omar: CI passed. executing manual promote.

deploy-bot: Promotion prom-20260324-21 proceeding (manual ack by release-manager).

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. prod-eu checkout-service running pinned digest sha256:aa11ff...; rollout 6/6 ready.

sre-oncall: monitoring live. no error spike observed in first 10m. will downgrade alert sensitivity after 15m if stable.

rachel: posting release note to #release-notes: "Operational: pinned checkout-service image digest in prod to avoid cross-region tag rewrite during promotion. No functional change."

omar: opened follow-up issue to harden CI and prevent this class of problem (chart/artifact replication + tag reuse): https://git.redwood/infra/issues/511. Proposed actions: enforce immutable tags, add chartmuseum replication check in pre-promotion gates, and add a small registry-consistency job to release CI.

infra-bot: Created infra issue 511 and assigned to registry squad.

release-manager: thanks team. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
